subject: How to remove duplicate items in transaction data for Association Analysis

messages.author: 0c68da0667a1bb8c
messages.subject: How to remove duplicate items in transaction data for Association Analysis
parts:
I get this message - 

One or more baskets appear to have repeated items. This is not handled by the internal conversion to transactions. Please pre-process your data to remove repeated items from any baskets. The actual error message was:

Error in asMethod(object) : 
  can not coerce list with transactions with duplicated items
 

Rattle 2.6.21

Is there a way to clean this in arules or elsewhere in R - or must I do it elsewhere - like in SPSS?
Regards
Mark

messages.author: 2db901f4366dc69b
messages.subject: Re: How to remove duplicate items in transaction data for Association Analysis
parts:
Hi Mark,

I also got this message. Since I was working with a CSV file with all the data in strings in the first column:

I opened Excel, 
highlighted the first column, 
went to the data tab, 
selected remove duplicates,
saved the file (with a different name),
and loaded it again with Rattle.

And if you wanted to do this in R, here is a link that explains it(for both vectors and dataframes): http://wiki.stdout.org/rcookbook/Manipulating%20data/Finding%20and%20removing%20duplicate%20records/

Best,
Andrew
